verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is an API-first payments platform, so it can run headlessly. It offers machine-to-machine auth through OAuth 2.0 client-credentials access keys or secret keys, and it has an official Node.js SDK. Safe automated retries come from idempotency keys, and a dedicated sandbox/test account with test cards and per-scenario testing supports automated test runs. Note that the MCP server needs an interactive Dashboard sign-in, so it is not itself a headless path. Missing for 10: an official CLI, explicit CI/CD integration guidance, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
